values.note: DCR: 'Four hundred campsites' (elsewhere 'close to 400'). ReserveAmerica sells 219 RV-type sites (171 Standard Non Electric, 48 RV/Trailer Non Electric): 150 take 30 ft, 39 take 25 ft, 1 takes 24 ft and 29 only 20 ft, so 190 fit a 23-ft motorhome - most in Charge Pond Areas A, E, F and B-South. The rest are popup/tent (82), tent-only (26), horse-required (33, Charge Pond Area C), group sites and yurts. All back-in.

note: MA DCR state forest in Carver/Plymouth: campground loops beside four kettle ponds (Charge, Fearing, Curlew, Barretts), plus a horse-only loop (Charge Pond Area C), group sites and three yurts. College Pond is the day-use swimming area; DCR asks campers to keep off the fragile pond shores where posted. --Claude

Pin ~1.6 km off: the stored pin (41.8320,-70.6940) sits on cranberry bogs south of the forest HQ, not on any campground loop. Most sites (Charge Pond Areas A-F, ~230 of ~360) are in the woods west and south of Charge Pond; OSM's campground node is at 41.8465,-70.6914, between Charge Pond and the small pond to its west, and RA's GPS (41.83917,-70.69222) is the HQ/Charge Pond entrance road. Suggest 41.8465,-70.6914.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront; not changed): DCR says sites are 'set along the edges of four of the park's many ponds', and RA tags 36 sites 'Near Water' - 12 of them RV-type sites, 11 of which (25 ft) a 23-ft motorhome can book (Fearing Pond H027, H028, H029, H033, H034; Barretts Pond J020, J023; Curlew Pond K022, K036, K040, K052; Barretts J025 is 20 ft), the rest popup/tent and tent-only. Loops are under pitch-pine canopy; needs a site-by-site look.
Horse-only loop: Charge Pond Area C (33 sites) is 'for campers bringing horses ONLY' - informational; the other loops are general camping.
